text:
Predicates:
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x is smarter.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is written by z.
Premises:
∀x ∀y (Reads(x, y) → GainsKnowledge(x)) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
∀x (GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Reads(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
Smarter(harry) ::: Harry is smarter than before.
